# Media Coverage Highlights: UHS and Talkspace Bring Together Virtual, Outpatient and Inpatient Care to Advance a Connected Behavioral Healthcare Continuum


UHS_Talkspace_logo


In August 2026, Universal Health Services (UHS) completed its acquisition of[Talkspace](https://www.talkspace.com/) , a leading virtual behavioral healthcare company, bringing together two organizations with complementary capabilities and a shared commitment to expanding access to high-quality mental healthcare.


The acquisition and the opportunities ahead have generated significant media interest, with coverage examining how UHS and Talkspace can help reshape the way behavioral healthcare is accessed, navigated and delivered.


## Modern Healthcare: Universal Health Services Acquires Talkspace for $835M


August 17, 2026 – Modern Healthcare highlighted the acquisition as part of UHS’ continued expansion of its behavioral health services. The publication noted that Talkspace adds a nationwide network of approximately 6,000 licensed providers and gives UHS an opportunity to offer a more comprehensive range of behavioral healthcare services.


[Read More](https://www.modernhealthcare.com/mergers-acquisitions/mh-universal-health-services-talkspace-acquisition/)


## Fierce Healthcare: Universal Health Services Closes $835M Talkspace Acquisition


August 17, 2026 – Fierce Healthcare examined how the acquisition creates opportunities for UHS and Talkspace to connect patients across the behavioral healthcare continuum. The coverage highlighted potential bidirectional referral pathways spanning virtual therapy and medication management, outpatient programs, emergency care and inpatient treatment.


[Read More](https://www.fiercehealthcare.com/finance/universal-health-services-closes-835m-talkspace-acquisition)


## Philadelphia Business Journal: UHS CEO Sees Talkspace Acquisition as More Than a Virtual Care Play


August 17, 2026 – The Philadelphia Business Journal spoke with Marc Miller about UHS’ long-term strategy for Talkspace and the future of behavioral healthcare. The coverage positioned the acquisition as a broader investment in how mental healthcare can evolve beyond traditional distinctions between virtual and facility-based care.


[Read More](https://www.bizjournals.com/philadelphia/news/2026/08/17/universal-health-services-talkspace-behavioral.html)


## Behavioral Health Business: UHS CEO Marc Miller on Talkspace, Outpatient Growth and What Comes Next


August 17, 2026 – Marc Miller discussed how Talkspace fits into UHS’ broader outpatient growth strategy as well as the potential for Talkspace to serve as an entry point into the broader UHS behavioral health continuum, while also providing virtual support for individuals transitioning from more intensive levels of care.


The conversation highlighted the opportunity to create stronger connections among virtual therapy, outpatient treatment, intensive outpatient and partial hospitalization programs, and inpatient behavioral healthcare.


[Read More](https://bhbusiness.com/2026/08/17/uhs-ceo-marc-miller-on-talkspace-outpatient-growth-and-what-comes-next/)


## Healthcare Dive: UHS CEO Speaks on Talkspace Bet


August 19, 2026 – In an in-depth interview, Marc Miller discussed why UHS views Talkspace as much more than a virtual care acquisition. He outlined opportunities to expand access, strengthen outpatient care and create more connected pathways for individuals whose behavioral health needs may change over time.


The interview also explored the strategic and financial rationale for the acquisition and UHS’ long-term vision for bringing together virtual and facility-based behavioral healthcare.


[Read More](https://www.healthcaredive.com/news/uhs-talkspace-acquisition-strategy-marc-miller-interview/828152/)


## CNBC Squawk Box: Talkspace CEO Dr. Jon Cohen on Responsible AI in Mental Health


August 21, 2026 – Talkspace CEO Jon R. Cohen, MD, joined CNBC’s Squawk Box to discuss the growing use of AI for mental health support and the importance of taking a clinically grounded, responsible approach to the technology.


Dr. Cohen discussed Tee, Talkspace’s purpose-built AI companion, and how it was developed with clinical expertise and safeguards to support individuals navigating everyday thoughts and emotions. The conversation highlighted the potential to combine innovation with clinical expertise as Talkspace and UHS begin their next chapter together.


[Watch the Interview](https://www.bing.com/search?q=CNBC+Squawk+Box%3A+Talkspace+CEO+Dr.+Jon+Cohen+on+Responsible+AI+in+Mental+Health&cvid=4b671be7014b4d688fd91f19e3310f83&gs_lcrp=EgRlZGdlKgYIABBFGDkyBggAEEUYOTIICAEQ6QcY_FUyBwgCEOsHGEDSAQc1MzRqMGo0qAIIsAIB&FORM=ANAB01&PC=U531)


## Philadelphia Inquirer: Universal Health Services Wants to Create Something New with Talkspace Acquisition


August 24, 2026 – The Philadelphia Inquirer spoke with UHS President and CEO Marc D. Miller about the strategy behind the acquisition and UHS’ vision for connecting Talkspace’s virtual capabilities with its existing behavioral health services. The article also explored Talkspace’s purpose-built AI companion, Tee, and the role responsible technology can play in supporting mental health.


[Read More](https://www.inquirer.com/health/uhs-talkspace-acquisition-behavioral-health-ai-tee--20260824.html)


## HealthLeaders: UHS CEO Marc Miller on Building a Connected Behavioral Health Ecosystem


September 4, 2026 – In a feature by Jay Asser, Marc Miller discussed how the Talkspace acquisition advances UHS’ vision for a more connected approach to behavioral healthcare.


Miller shared how bringing Talkspace’s virtual capabilities together with UHS’ extensive behavioral health network creates new opportunities to connect people with the right level of care as their needs change. The conversation also explored UHS’ continued investment in outpatient services, the role of technology in expanding access and the potential to create stronger pathways across virtual, outpatient and inpatient care.


[Read More](https://www.healthleadersmedia.com/ceo/uhs-ceo-future-behavioral-health-connected-continuum)


## About the Acquisition


UHS completed its acquisition of Talkspace on August 17, 2026. Talkspace now operates as a UHS company, bringing its nationwide virtual behavioral health platform together with UHS’ extensive behavioral health inpatient and outpatient network.


The combination is designed to expand access and give individuals more options for receiving appropriate behavioral healthcare as their needs evolve – while creating stronger connections across virtual, outpatient and inpatient settings.


[Learn more about Talkspace and the future of behavioral healthcare](https://uhs.com/what-we-do/behavioral-health/talkspace/)
